messages.author: 26c971075f8aedcc
messages.subject: libRlapack.dylib issue with INLA_18.05.28 on Mac
parts:
Hi,

I am debugging some models and wanted to test the bug against the testing version of INLA. After running

> install.packages("INLA", repos=c(getOption("repos"), INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing"), dep=TRUE)

I tried to use INLA but got this error

> library(package = "INLA")
Loading required package: Matrix
Loading required package: sp
This is INLA_18.05.28 built 2018-06-12 14:08:32 UTC.
See www.r-inla.org/contact-us for how to get help.
To enable PARDISO sparse library; see inla.pardiso()

> Fit = inla(formula = phenotype ~ yearLocation, data = PYTPheno)
dyld: Library not loaded: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.4/Resources/lib/libRlapack.dylib
  Referenced from: /usr/local/lib/R/3.4/site-library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla
  Reason: image not found
sh: line 1: 37575 Abort trap: 6           '/usr/local/lib/R/3.4/site-library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run' -b -s -v '/private/var/folders/g5/sbdzf6d91s575syj47hxb2wr0000gt/T/RtmpORbNQE/file201173899fcc/Model.ini' > /private/var/folders/g5/sbdzf6d91s575syj47hxb2wr0000gt/T/RtmpORbNQE/file201173899fcc/Logfile.txt
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

I have not seen this error before with earlier INLA versions. Also note that on Mac I do not have libRlapack, but Mac's LAPACK

> La_library()
[1] "/System/Library/Frameworks/Accelerate.framework/Versions/A/Frameworks/vecLib.framework/Versions/A/libLAPACK.dylib"

Thanks!

Gregor

messages.author: 26c971075f8aedcc
messages.subject: Re: libRlapack.dylib issue with INLA_18.05.28 on Mac
parts:
Hi,

Has anyone found a way to solve the issue described below (INLA does not find libRlapack.dylib)?

I have R (3.5 or 3.6) on Mac installed via brew, which comes with OpenBLAS.

My attempt to work around this issue was to soft-linked OpenBLAS into INLA lib folder

cd /usr/local/lib/R/3.6/site-library/INLA/bin/Mac/64bit

ln -s /usr/local/Cellar/openblas/0.3.6_1/lib/*.dylib .

ln -s libopenblas.dylib libRlapack.dylib


But I now get version error when I try ti run inla() - for some reason OpenBLAS version is 0.0.0:

dyld: Library not loaded: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.5/Resources/lib/libRlapack.dylib
  Referenced from: /usr/local/lib/R/3.6/site-library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla
  Reason: Incompatible library version: inla requires version 3.5.0 or later, but libRlapack.dylib provides version 0.0.0

Any other ideas what I could try?

Thanks!

gg
